findings.message: 1 granule position does not match the samples of the packets before it: the first, at 0x1B6, is 1460 where the packets give 2360. Players that take the time from them show it wrong.
The granule position of the logical stream 0x00006E6E goes back once, the first time at 0x1B0 from 1560 to 1460; players that seek or show the time by it get lost.
1 page of the logical stream 0x00006E6E completes a packet but has the granule position -1, which RFC 3533 keeps for pages on which no packet ends. The first at 0x234.
1 page of the logical stream 0x00006E6E completes no packet but has a granule position (3959 at 0x2B8, the first) instead of -1, which RFC 3533 requires there.
